mines.mine_notes: Tongguan Taizhou Mining Company Limited, Tongguan County, Shaanxi (Xiaoqinling gold region). FY2025/26: ore production 70,405 t at 4.23 g/t; gold produced 298 kg (9,581 oz), gold sold 306 kg as concentrates (revenue HK$284.2M at HK$929/gram). Mining right permit C6100002014084120135479 renewed in FY2025/26, valid 31 July 2025 to 31 July 2027. ESG focus asset; 19,212 m of tunnel development completed in FY2025/26. Per-mine AISC/cash cost not disclosed.
mines.processing: Underground mining; mineral processing with gold concentrates as product; mine development and technical revamp capex ~RMB128M in FY2025/26

notes: Fiscal year ended 31 March 2026 (fiscal_year shown as 2026). Listed on HKEX GEM (stock code 8299); incorporated in the Cayman Islands. FY2025/26: revenue HK$1,966.2M (+49.6%), gross profit HK$231.8M (margin 11.8%), profit for the year HK$144.3M, net profit attributable to equity holders HK$94.9M. Two segments: gold mining operation (Taizhou gold concentrates) and refining operation (purchased feed: gold bullion sold 1,618 kg, silver bullion 13,715 kg, copper/lead/zinc concentrates — not mine production). March 2026 agreement to acquire Ningshan County Bubugao Mining and Ningshan Jincheng Mining (Shaanxi) for HK$585M (HK$247M cash + 676M shares at HK$0.5); completed 29 June 2026, after fiscal year-end — not included in FY2025/26 mine figures. Deep-ore exploration programme in Xiaoqinling with Shaanxi Geology and Mineral Group. Reserves/resources per SRK Consulting China technical due diligence (JORC 2012, effective 31 March 2026) relate to the Group's Shaanxi mining assets (Taizhou). Company does not disclose AISC or per-mine cash costs. report_url not captured at download time (null).
